outcome: rate of neonatal respiratory distress syndrome/transient tachypnea (RDS/TTN)
cohort: 454 singleton pregnancies and 398 twin pregnancies delivered by cesarean section between 24 and 38 weeks of gestation
finding: Twin fetuses had a lower rate of RDS/TTN and higher amniotic lamellar body counts, suggesting more rapid lung maturation compared to singleton fetuses.
